race.comment: BARBARINO (1) is a talented type for Bill Papazaharoudakis who was well backed and won accordingly on debut at Caulfield Heath back in May, scoring by 1.75 lengths. He was put away and finds a very nice race first up here. Can remain unbeaten. ASTIQUER (8) resumes having shown ability in three runs last time in, winning dominantly on debut, okay in two runs thereafter. Expected to improve this time around. CIRCUS LIGHTS (7) is another first-upper with solid 3yo form last campaign. Should go well. NGONGOTAHA (6) is also first up with ability although 1200m is on the sharper side. MIGHTY MYSTIC (3) returns from a spell. Ran fourth in latest jump-out at Pakenham. Can feature fresh.
